summary: Tested Listmonk integration (backend via pytest against public URL + real Listmonk at newsletter.tuningfux.de) and the content editor UI (Playwright). Placeholder removal, connection test, upsert logic and editor all work, but the main feature is broken: Listmonk rejects every campaign template upload because the templates no longer contain {{ template "content" . }}. Listmonk requires this placeholder exactly once in campaign-type templates. 'Zu Listmonk' and 'Alle zu Listmonk exportieren' both fail with 400.

critical.issue: Returns 400 for every app template: Listmonk responds 'Der Platzhalter "{{ template "content" . }}" darf nur einmal im Template vorkommen.' Campaign-type templates must contain the placeholder exactly once. Removing it from all templates means nothing can be uploaded or updated. I checked it: the same request with the placeholder gets 200 'erstellt', and a second request gets 200 'aktualisiert' with the same id. So the upsert logic itself works.

minor.issue: A non-existent id returns 400 with the placeholder error from Listmonk, not 404. Listmonk validates the body before it checks the id.

Each upsert fetches the full template list (including every body) just to match a name. Matching is exact, so templates the user renamed in Listmonk get duplicated. Sync requests calls block the async event loop (use httpx.AsyncClient).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Bestellsumme' field writes data.orderTotal, but TransactionTemplate reads 'total' (and 'subtotal'). Editing it does not change the preview.
The 'Intro Text' field writes data.introText, but NewsletterTemplate never reads introText (it uses subheadline). Editing it does not change the preview.
The password defaults use resetLink/validityTime, but the template reads resetUrl/expiryTime. The welcome default ctaText is not used by WelcomeTemplate. These defaults are dead data.

integration_issues.flow: Upload current template ('Zu Listmonk') and 'Alle zu Listmonk exportieren'
integration_issues.issue: The error toast shows the raw Listmonk placeholder error and no template is created or updated. 'Alle exportieren' fails for all 6 templates.

issues: The editor panel sits below the preview, so you must scroll to see live changes. Consider a side-by-side layout.
Raw JSON from Listmonk is shown in the error toast. Map it to a friendly German message.

action_items: CRITICAL: Re-think the placeholder fix. Listmonk campaign templates MUST contain {{ template "content" . }} exactly once. The Lorem ipsum comes from the campaign's own body, which Listmonk renders at the placeholder. Options: (a) put the placeholder back once, at the main content spot, and tell the user to fill in or clear the campaign body; (b) put the editable content into a campaign instead, via POST/PUT /api/campaigns with content_type html and the body set, using a minimal template that has the placeholder; (c) put the placeholder in a neutral spot and create campaigns with an empty body.
Fix editor field name mismatches: orderTotal -> total (and subtotal) in Transaction, introText -> subheadline (or support introText) in Newsletter, and align the password/welcome default keys.
Add data-testid attributes to all buttons and inputs on EmailTemplatePage (there are currently 0).
Show a user-friendly toast for Listmonk errors.
critical_code_review_comments: EmailTemplatePage.js is 816 lines, with the editor fields hard-coded per template. Split it into components and drive the fields from a per-template field schema to avoid key mismatches.
No data-testid attributes anywhere on the page.
Backend uses blocking requests calls inside async endpoints.
get_listmonk_auth uses os.environ.get with '' defaults. LISTMONK_* vars are not in backend/.env (they are injected into the process env), so they may be missing on deploy.
handleUploadAllToListmonk counts failures but does not say which templates failed.

success_rate.backend: 86% (6/7 pytest; the one failure is the core upload, which is critical)
success_rate.frontend: ~70% (editor opens and closes, 5/7 tested fields update the preview, upload fails)

seed_data_creation: I created temporary Listmonk templates TEST_ListmonkUpsert_Agent_ph (id 38) and TEST_Upsert_PH (id 39) and deleted both by id. No user data was changed: the UI upload attempts were rejected by Listmonk with 400.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Listmonk creds are in the backend process env (not in backend/.env). Get them from /proc/<uvicorn pid>/environ to clean up TEST_ templates via DELETE {LISTMONK_API_URL}api/templates/{id}. Existing TFD templates in Listmonk are ids 32-37 and still contain the placeholder from older uploads. The editor uses input ids: #headline, #subheadline, #mainTitle, #salePrice, #orderTotal, #customerName, #introText, #content, etc.
rca of the issue: Listmonk validates campaign templates (regexpTplTag) and requires {{ template "content" . }} exactly once. The main agent removed the placeholder to stop the Lorem ipsum from showing. But Lorem ipsum is the default body of a new Listmonk campaign, and the placeholder is where Listmonk injects that body. Removing the placeholder makes Listmonk reject the template (400). Repro: POST /api/listmonk/templates with any generated template HTML returns 400. Mitigation: restore the placeholder once and handle the content through the campaign body (see action_items).
